publication.technical: Evaluate undamped unforced linear spring motion released from rest using positive constant mass and stiffness, signed initial displacement from equilibrium and signed time. Return positive natural angular frequency, displacement, velocity and acceleration. Correct the source missing square root and derivative aliases, replace singular division and retain alternative signed frequency branches with independent zero-amplitude qualification.
publication.plain: Supply mass in kilograms, stiffness in newtons per meter, initial displacement in meters and time in seconds with identical nonempty shapes. The spring must provide the net linear restoring force, with zero initial velocity and no damping or driving. Receive natural angular frequency and complete position, velocity and acceleration. Large-phase calculations treat converted float64 inputs as exact; they cannot recover missing measurement precision.

bound.validity_statement: Positive constant mass and stiffness; undamped unforced linear spring, signed initial displacement and time, zero initial velocity. All four outputs must be representable; phase computed from exact converted float64 inputs.
